releaseNotes.en: First release. Notes you save come back when they are relevant, every question can be recorded automatically, and Save to memory works on selected text, clipboard entries and screenshots. Nothing leaves your Mac.
releaseNotes.zh-hans: 首个版本。存过的笔记会在用得上的时候自动带回来，每次提问都可以自动记录，划词、剪贴板和截图都能「存入记忆」。所有内容都留在本机。
